name: Facet
text: Choose a single dark theme with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. High contrast ensures visibility and liveliness, matching our dark-themed competitors like Manus and Graphify. The toggle keeps the option open without cluttering the interface, trading a slight visual inconsistency for universal usability. This balances speed and clarity for all users.

name: Pane
text: The one-click toggle assumes users will tolerate switching modes—some won’t, and a permanent preference toggle still forces users to make a choice upfront. Instead, default to dark mode but let users *opt into* light mode via a subtle, non-intrusive setting, trading the toggle’s clutter for a cleaner interface that respects user inertia. Settle it by testing both: if light-mode opt-ins stay below 10%, the toggle was overkill.

name: Facet
text:
Do a persistent one-click toggle between dark and light mode. High contrast in dark mode meets our visibility and liveliness goals, while the toggle keeps the interface flexible without permanent clutter. The trade-off is a slight visual inconsistency when switching, but it preserves user choice without forcing an upfront decision.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A one-click toggle still risks users getting stuck in the wrong mode—imagine a user toggling to light mode for one task, then forgetting to switch back, degrading visibility for all subsequent work. Instead, default to dark mode with a *temporary* light mode override (clears on session end), trading the toggle’s permanence for a cleaner, more predictable experience. Settle it with A/B testing: measure task completion time and error rates in both modes—if the override performs better, adopt it.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to high-contrast dark mode with a temporary light mode override (clears on session end), no persistent toggle.

Result: A single, consistent dark interface that users can temporarily lighten without clutter or forced choices. Owned by Facet.
